keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Florin Tanase (Omonia Nicosia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Juventus 0, Omonia Nicosia 1. Lubomír Satka (Omonia Nicosia) header from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Muamer Tankovic with a cross following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Thomas Kaminski (Omonia Nicosia).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Jhon Lucumí (Juventus) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Juventus 1, Omonia Nicosia 1. Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Francisco Conceição.
Goal! Juventus 2, Omonia Nicosia 1. Jeff Ekhator (Juventus) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Francisco Conceição.
Substitution, Juventus. Zeki Çelik replaces Juan Cabal.
Substitution, Omonia Nicosia. Loïs Diony replaces Andronikos Kakoullis.
Substitution, Omonia Nicosia. Ewandro replaces Florin Tanase.
Second Half begins Juventus 2, Omonia Nicosia 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Loïs Diony (Omonia Nicosia).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Omonia Nicosia. Luuk Brouwers replaces Panagiotis Andreou.
Substitution, Omonia Nicosia. Jure Balkovec replaces Loïc Négo.
Substitution, Juventus. Teun Koopmeiners replaces Douglas Luiz.
Substitution, Juventus. Nick Woltemade replaces Jeff Ekhator.
Weston McKennie (Juventus) Substitution at 66'
Goal! Juventus 3, Omonia Nicosia 1. Francisco Conceição (Juventus) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Omonia Nicosia. Angelos Neophytou replaces Muamer Tankovic.
Goal! Juventus 4, Omonia Nicosia 1. Jérémie Boga (Juventus) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Andrea Cambiaso.
Jure Balkovec (Omonia Nicosia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Juventus. Randal Kolo Muani replaces Francisco Conceição.
Second Half ends, Juventus 4, Omonia Nicosia 1.
